basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer from Tacoma, Washington, diving into the world of Reddit and Fallout 76. I work in IT support, which gives me plenty of time to explore gaming in the evenings. Outside of work, I'm passionate about strategy games and dabbling in Spanish as a new hobby. I'm single and usually online during late nights, Pacific Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in IT and technology, primarily self-taught through online courses and hands-on experience. My interest in gaming started as a child, and I've always been keen on learning new languages, which led me to start learning Spanish recently.
